items.html: Also another aspect was added now. And it is that behold, as stated above, the five Hassadim that are in the Daat already spread upward in the five Sefirot of the Tzelem itself, before it entered to become inner Mochin for ZA, and they are in its ChGT NH of the Tzelem. And behold, it was also explained in the previous discourse that the Hassadim, when they are closed within the Yesod of Tevunah, do not spread until they are revealed and come out of that mouth of the corona. If so, it is found that in the first six years, when the articles of the NHY of Tevunah were entering into ZA, also those Hassadim that spread in them were entering into ZA, each one in its place, in each and every article; and this was until his completion to six years. However, in the last three years, which are the seventh, eighth, ninth, and one day, the three lower Hassadim, less a third, descend — for these are always revealed, as mentioned in the discourse — and then these descended, each one to its true place.
